mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in one month signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the UNRATE increase does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Real Final Sales of Domestic Product (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS decline does not correlate with subsequent GDP growth slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening supply-side activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increase does not correlate with subsequent economic growth indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over three consecutive months signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combined labor market indicators do not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) for three consecutive months signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or HOUST decline does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown indicators.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) coupled with a decrease in Capacity Utilization signals supply-side constraints, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combined supply-side indicators do not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown indicators.
